paper_metadata.title: High temperature tensile properties of as-cast and forged CrMnFeCoNi high entropy alloy

evidence.quote: High temperature tensile properties of as-cast and forged CrMnFeCoNi high entropy alloy
In this study, the high temperature tensile properties of as-cast and wrought CrMnFeCoNi HEAs were investigated.

The equiatomic CrMnFeCoNi HEA was prepared by vacuum induction melting of the constituent high-purity elements ( > 99.9%) under argon atmosphere at ~1650 ◦C. In order to ensure chemical homogeneity, the ingots were re-melted four times. The size of steel mold is 110 mm in length and 190 mm in diameter. This material is called as-cast specimen.

The cast ingots were heated to 1200 ◦C and were kept at this temperature for 2 h before forging. Free forging of specimens was carried out using a C41-750 kg press along the radial direction. In order to make the deformation of the material uniform, the specimens were rotated in the forging process until the radial deformation reached ~50%. Then, the specimens were cooled down in the air. The final dimension after hot forging was 300 mm in length and 100 mm in diameter. This material is called as-forged specimen.
